data.name: Hassnain
data.gender_notes: Hassnain is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A man of good looks and excellent character. The name Hassnain carries the meaning “Handsome, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hassnain usually hope their child will grow to embody handsome, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of God, meaning the one who is beautiful in His attributes and perfect in His actions
data.etymology: Hassnain belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Handsome, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hassnain total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
